name: Hexagon 4438
description: A regular 6-sided polygon (a Hexagon) with side 7.24, drawn on the image grid. The table gives its perimeter, apothem, area and interior angle, every value computed from the side count and side length.
history: Hexagon 4438 is a Hexagon measure in The Signature Image Grid and Measure Database. The figure is drawn as an SVG in the archive’s grid style and measured on the grid: every table value is computed from the figure’s inputs, never typed in by hand. The archive holds 7560 measures; 1517 are regular polygon (20.1%).
science_proof: Regular polygon geometry: the apothem is side / (2 tan(π/n)), the perimeter is n times the side, the area is half the perimeter times the apothem, and each interior angle is (n−2) × 180° / n.
math_proof: Derivation from the stored inputs n = 6 sides, side = 7.24. Apothem: s/(2 tan(π/n)) = 7.24/(2 tan(0.5236)) = 6.27. Perimeter: n·s = 43.44. Area: n·s·apothem/2 = 136.1849. Interior angle: (n−2) × 180°/n = 4 × 180°/6 = 120°. Every stored table value was recomputed from the primary inputs during validation; the largest difference between a stored value and its recomputation is 0.0000 (rounding only).
